column3: “As follows we said to them” is rendered “we told them accordingly.”
“Stone of rolling” is rendered “huge stones,” and “diligently” as “with great care.”
“From the former time of this, many years” is rendered “many years ago.”
“Vessels” is rendered “utensils”; NASB supplies “these” and “one whose.”
“On its place” is rendered “in its place.”
“The will of the king” is rendered “his decision.”
